request.description: Set OPENWEATHER_API_KEY privately in your Postman environment. Do not export or screenshot its value. This request retrieves current conditions, not today's forecast.

exec: pm.test('Miami and required weather fields', () => { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data.name).to.eql('Miami'); pm.expect(data.main.temp).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(data.weather[0].description).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });
